title: Install/remove of the viewed set treats Ok(None) (request skipped as busy) as success
trigger: Open a set box, press Add/Remove Stickers while a ManageStickerSet or reorder request for that set is still pending (double click, or right after the manager box closed)
effect: manage_sticker_set returns Ok(None) without sending; the box closes and the toast says 'Sticker set added/removed' though nothing was sent. With Ok(Some) the same success note and close happen before TDLib answers, so a later failure leaves a wrong note
fix: Match Ok(Some)/Ok(None)/Err separately; keep the box in an 'Installing' stage (button disabled, as sticker_set_action does) until the answer, close on success only

title: Archive of the viewed set closes the box and notes 'archived' on Ok(None)
trigger: Press Archive Stickers while a request for the same set is pending
effect: Same as install: nothing sent, box closes and 'archived' note shown
fix: Same stage enum for the set action; answer-driven close

title: A finished old encode clears the encoding handle of a newer encode
trigger: Press Done on a video sticker, cancel the box (cancel flag only stops between quality steps), open Create Sticker again and press Done before the first encode returns
effect: The old continuation sets sticker_box.encoding = None unconditionally; the new encode then finds encoding None, so current is false and its result is dropped. Done is enabled again, the box stays open, nothing is uploaded and the new encode can no longer be cancelled
fix: Make encoding an enum Idle|Encoding{token,cancel} and clear it only when the finishing job's token still matches

title: The set box's editing flow is spread over create, encoding, pick, pending_still, pending_video and four modal bools
trigger: Any create/adapt/rename/delete flow
effect: Stages (choosing, decoding still, downloading video, editing, naming emojis, encoding) are Options and bools reset by hand in reset(); reordering, rename_open, delete_set_open, remove_set_open and delete_sticker can be set together
fix: One enum SetEdit {Idle, Reordering, Renaming, ConfirmDeleteSticker(item), ConfirmDeleteSet, ConfirmRemoveSet, Picking(pick), DecodingStill(..), DownloadingVideo(..), Naming(create), Encoding{create,cancel}}

title: A chosen video that fails to download leaves pending_video set with no progress or error
trigger: In Adapt from a Sticker, pick a WEBM (or a saved GIF) that is not downloaded and let the download fail or the app be offline
effect: The chooser closed, nothing is shown, no editor ever opens; pending_video stays until the set box closes. Without a live driver it never resolves
fix: Add a Downloading stage that shows progress and has an error exit when the file's download ends without a path

title: Picking a not-downloaded still sticker to adapt never requests the file
trigger: In Adapt from a Sticker (or Add existing), choose a webp sticker whose file is not on disk (library set never opened)
effect: local_media_path is None, the off-thread job returns None, edit_pixels_for_set shows 'Could not load image' (the WEBM branch downloads, this one does not)
fix: Download the file and wait in the DownloadingStill stage like pending_video

title: upload_created_sticker drops the New Sticker box as if uploaded when the send failed
trigger: Press Done on a New Sticker with the driver channel failing (or no longer owning the set: owned_set_name None gives InvalidRequest)
effect: An error toast shows but create is cleared, the box closes and the user's edited image and chosen emoji are lost; the editor PNG (create.path) is also never removed
fix: Clear create only on Ok; on Err stay in the Naming stage

title: Account switch leaves the set box's encode running and its editor files behind
trigger: Press Done on a video sticker, switch account
effect: OnScreen is replaced whole; the empty Farewell does not set the encode cancel flag nor call CreateSticker::discard, so ffmpeg keeps running to completion and the editor PNG/preview stay in temp
fix: Farewell calls reset()

title: Validation messages sent as Silent notes are dropped while a toast is showing
trigger: Press Done with no emoji (EMOJI_REQUIRED_NOTE), or add to a full set, within 3-6 s of another toast
effect: ConnectionUi::set_note_in discards Silent notes while the current note is a toast; the user gets no reason why Done did nothing
fix: Use StatusNote::info for refusals the screen does not show by itself

title: Manager box closes and clears its edits as if saved; later commit steps fail silently
trigger: Mark sets removed and drag a new order, close the box; the removal succeeds but the reorder step fails, or the connection is down
effect: finish_manager clears the edits first; commit errors after the first step are discarded by pump_sticker_manager (let _) and commits.clear() drops the rest, so removals/order are lost with no note after the first step
fix: Keep edits until the commit queue reports done, or report the failing step with a toast and reopen offer

title: ManagerView.loading and failed are copies of session flags (installed_loaded, requests.has_purpose, panel.failed)
trigger: Open the manager and switch tabs
effect: Loading is derived from three sources by hand per tab; failed is one bool shared by all tabs (a failed Trending page shows 'could not update' on Installed)
fix: Per-tab Fetch<Vec<StickerSetInfo>> in the panel state

title: The manager box shares the composer sticker panel's tab and open flag
trigger: Open the composer sticker panel on Favorites, then Settings > Manage sticker sets, close it
effect: open_archived_stickers sets the shared panel tab to Installed and close_sticker_panel closes the composer panel's state
fix: Give the manager its own tab state

title: In the masks box one pending change disables Add on every row
trigger: Press Add on one archived mask set
effect: mask_change_pending() is not keyed by set, so all rows show loading and disabled until the answer
fix: Key the pending test by set id as for stickers

title: Player and UiClip keep stage as Cell<bool>/Option/bool combinations
trigger: Any sticker shown
effect: pump and closer are 'task started' bools reset by hand; UiClip.timeline + failed + ready_at + shown mirror the engine's ClipState (Opening/Ready/Failed) and failed is sticky until the clip closes
fix: UiClip::state enum {Opening, Ready{timeline}, Failed}; closer/pump as Option<Task> handles

title: The pump redraws the whole app on every drained batch, not only for a first frame
trigger: Any animated sticker or emoji playing
effect: The doc says it redraws when a clip opened or its first frame is ready, but drain()'s first-frame result is ignored and cx.notify() runs for every worker wake, so layered emoji (meant to avoid rebuilding slices) still rebuild the app per decoded frame
fix: Notify only when drain() returned true

title: MessageName status head is keyed by the bare message id
trigger: Two chats show a premium sender status on messages with the same numeric id
effect: status_head hashes (surface, message_id, status_id) with no chat, so both views share one play head: a loop count spent in one chat is spent in the other
fix: Key the head by ChatMessage

title: greeting_loaded is set when the request is sent, not when answered
trigger: Open an empty private chat once while offline or the request fails
effect: The flag means 'requested'; a failure is never retried this session so the greeting never shows, and the UI cannot tell loading from loaded
fix: Fetch<Vec<StickerItem>> for greeting with a retry on reconnect

title: The picker status line is built from loading_tab, loading_set, failed and search_has_more
trigger: Sticker panel in any tab
effect: failed is one bool for every tab and loading_set a second flag beside request purposes; an error in one tab shows in all and can sit beside loading
fix: Per-tab Fetch<T>

title: Gift Stars pack answer is not matched to the contact it was asked for
trigger: Open Gift Stars, pick contact A (packs load), press Back before they arrive, pick contact B; A's getStarGiftPaymentOptions answer lands first (purpose GetStarGiftOptions carries no user id).
effect: B's page shows A's packs and loading=false while B's request is still in flight (or A's error shows under B); Buy builds the invoice from A's pack with B's user id.
fix: Make the stage one enum (Contacts | Loading{user} | Ready{user,packs} | Failed{user,msg}) and carry the user id in the request purpose; apply the answer only when it matches the current Loading{user}.

title: Gift Stars dialog stage is open + target + loading + error + options kept in step by clear_target
trigger: Any pick/back/close/answer sequence.
effect: Render branches on loading, then error, then options.is_empty(); choose_stars_gift_user send failure leaves target set with loading=false and no error (shows 'No options available').
fix: enum StarsGiftStage { Closed, Contacts, Packs(Fetch<Vec<StarPack>> with user) }.

title: Refresh (or Retry) removes the cached statistics before the send can fail, leaving a spinner with no retry
trigger: Open channel statistics, lose the connection (chats_path inactive) or have the request refused, press Refresh. refresh_chat_statistics removes the entry first, then fetch_chat_statistics returns Err.
effect: Panel shows 'Loading statistics' spinner forever (None is drawn like Loading, no Retry button) until the panel is closed and reopened; the loaded numbers are gone.
fix: Do not remove the entry; set it to Loading only after a successful send, or to Failed on Err. Draw None as Idle with a Load button.

title: Statistics panel spins forever when the fetch is skipped because can_get_statistics is not known yet
trigger: Open the Statistics panel on a channel before supergroupFullInfo has loaded (or via the message menu 'Statistics' on a fresh chat). fetch_chat_statistics returns Ok(None) without inserting any entry; nothing refetches when the full info arrives.
effect: 'Loading statistics, it can take a few minutes' forever; also for a chat whose full info says can_get_statistics=false.
fix: Idle/Unavailable variants in ChatStatisticsFetch; draw None as 'not available' or retrigger the fetch when the full info arrives.

title: Every redraw of the statistics panel deep-clones the whole ChatStatistics, so the parsed-chart cache never hits and every graph is re-parsed
trigger: Hover or drag over any chart (ChartState notifies and redraws the panel): chat_statistics.get().cloned() copies every graph's JSON string, so parsed_chart's key (pointer,len) is new each time.
effect: Re-parse of up to ~10 graphs plus deep ChatStatistics equality in ChartState::sync on every hover frame (wasted work on the UI thread).
fix: Hold the loaded statistics in an Rc/Arc and key the chart cache by Rc identity or a content hash.

title: Parsed-chart cache is keyed by buffer address and length with a 3x128 byte sample, so a reused address can return a stale chart
trigger: A statistics refresh frees the old JSON string and the new one of the same length is allocated at the same address with equal first/middle/last 128 bytes but different values elsewhere.
effect: The old chart is drawn for the new data until the cache is cleared at 64 entries.
fix: Key by a hash of the full JSON, or hold Rc<StatChart> in the state next to the graph.

title: ZoomedDay is chart: Option + error: Option, both None meaning 'loading'
trigger: Zoom into a day; GraphFetch Loading/Loaded/Failed is mapped to two Options in stat_graph_section.
effect: Loading and failed-to-parse are told apart only by which Option is set.
fix: ZoomedDay { x, fetch: Fetch<Rc<StatChart>> }.

title: An async graph whose load failed disappears from the panel with no message or retry
trigger: Open statistics; a getStatisticalGraph request fails (flood wait, network). stat_graph_section re-requests only on None; GraphFetch::Failed hits '_ => return None'.
effect: The chart section is silently missing until the whole panel is refreshed (load_stat_graph itself would resend on Failed but is never called).
fix: Render Failed as a section with the error and a Retry button that calls load_stat_graph.

title: Export writes a workbook that silently lacks graphs that are still loading or failed, and then reports success
trigger: Open channel statistics while async graphs (mute graph etc.) are loading or one failed, press Export to File.
effect: File saved with missing sheets; the toast says the export is done.
fix: Refuse (or warn) while any async graph of the page is Loading or Failed.

title: Opening a story's statistics sets the page before the request and keeps it when the send fails
trigger: Click a recent story row with the connection gate inactive; set_page(Story) runs, fetch_story_insights returns Err (note shown).
effect: Story page shows 'Loading statistics' with no state to ever answer it and no retry; only Back leaves.
fix: Set the page only after the fetch is accepted, or insights becomes Fetch with Failed and a Retry.

title: Story statistics Failed state has no Retry (message statistics has one); a failed Retry send is dropped silently
trigger: Story statistics request fails; or Retry on message statistics when the send is refused.
effect: Error text only; user must go back and reopen. Retry Err result is discarded with 'let _ ='.
fix: Retry button for story page; surface Err from retry_message_statistics as a note.

title: Failed poll votes graph shows nothing and is never retried
trigger: Open message statistics of a poll when getStatisticalGraph for poll votes fails (PollStatsFetch::Failed).
effect: Poll section silently absent ('_ => {}').
fix: Draw the error and a retry like the other pages.

title: Public shares list is loading: bool + error: Option + next_offset + list passed as separate arguments
trigger: Message page: forwards.loading/forwards.error; story page: forwards_loading/forwards_error.
effect: Both loading and an error line can show; 'Show more' hides while loading.
fix: Fetch<Page> per list with next_offset inside the ready variant.

title: Statistics keep the colors of the theme they were fetched in
trigger: Open statistics in light theme, switch to dark; the cached Loaded result is kept and getChatStatistics(is_dark) is not resent.
effect: Chart colors do not follow the theme until the user presses Refresh.
fix: Store the is_dark the result was fetched for in the Loaded variant and refetch when it differs.

title: Report option picker stays after a pick, so a second click sends the report twice
trigger: In the sponsored report picker click an option, then click again before the reportSponsoredResult answer arrives.
effect: Two reportChatSponsoredMessage requests; second may fail with an error note after the first 'Report sent'.
fix: SponsoredReportFlight becomes Picking{options} | Sending{option} | Done and the panel disables on Sending.

title: Sponsored report is sponsored_report: Option + last_sponsored_report: Option, each drawn when chat id matches
trigger: Report an ad: flight, then outcome.
effect: Flight and outcome can both exist (picker and outcome banner drawn together) after a second report.
fix: One enum SponsoredReport { None, Picking, Sending, Outcome }.

title: The Forward-to chooser's open state is 'choosing is non-empty' next to a search field reset by hand
trigger: Files arrive from outside; begin/close/choose each clear choosing and search separately.
effect: Dialog is_open, the search text and the file list must be kept in step in close_start_files and choose_start_files_chat.
fix: enum StartFiles { Idle, Choosing{files, search} }.

title: Files picked for a chat are dropped when that chat does not open synchronously
trigger: Choose a chat in the Forward-to chooser while select_listed_chat cannot open it (open_chat_id() != chat): files were already taken from choosing.
effect: Chooser closes, note 'Open the chat to attach' and the files are lost.
fix: Keep the files until the chat is open (Choosing -> Attaching{chat}), attach on open, restore on failure.

title: Account switch closes the chooser and drops the waiting files
trigger: Files sent via 'Send to' while the chooser is open; user switches account (StartFiles uses .close).
effect: Files vanish silently; the chooser is gone.
fix: Keep the files app-wide until chosen or cancelled (they are app state), re-listing chats for the new account.

title: GPU-loss recovery is recovered: Cell<bool> + kept: RefCell<Option<KeptWindow>> + gpu_gone read from the platform
trigger: Window closes after a GPU or renderer loss.
effect: 'recovered' is set before the reopen succeeds and never reset, so any second renderer loss in the whole process life quits the app even days after a good recovery; kept must be taken in step with the step chosen.
fix: enum Recovery { Healthy, Recovering, Recovered{at} } with a reset after a successful reopen.

title: Recover waits on request_windowing with no way out
trigger: GPU lost on Windows with no windows left; the windowing request future never completes.
effect: QuitMode::Explicit and no window: the process stays alive invisible, nothing quits.
fix: Give the await an exit (platform error, quit-asked, or a manual-clock deadline) that ends in give_up.

title: QUIT_ASKED is never cleared if a platform quit request is declined
trigger: A macOS terminate or session-end callback goes through noting_quit and then does not quit.
effect: Later main-window renderer loss: main_lost is false, so the main window is not reopened and the app keeps running with only chat windows or none.
fix: Set it only when the quit proceeds, or reset it when the quit is cancelled.

title: Media spoiler tile (60 frames of 3000 specks) is built inside paint on the UI thread and rebuilt after every 3 s idle release
trigger: Scroll to a chat with a spoiler photo, scroll away for 3+ s, scroll back.
effect: Frame hitch of tens of ms (about 4.5M speck stamps and 16 MB allocation) each time.
fix: Build off-thread into a Loading/Ready tile, and release only under memory pressure.

title: Spoiler reveal fades are keyed by bare chat id and message id, not account
trigger: Reveal a spoiler in a chat open in two accounts, switch account within 200 ms.
effect: Cover fade state read by the other account's same chat/message key.
fix: RevealKey uses AccountChat/ChatMessage owner keys.

title: range/_range_changes and pie/_pie_changes are Option pairs kept in step by hand
trigger: sync(), reset_range(), enter_pie() and exit_pie() set and clear the Option and its Subscription separately.
effect: A subscription can outlive or miss its slider if one site forgets the pair.
fix: Put the Subscription inside RangeSelector/PieZoom so they drop together.

title: Similar-channels strip re-requests getChatSimilarChats every frame after a failed fetch
trigger: Open a joined channel whose getChatSimilarChats fails (flood wait, API error). Render calls similar_channels_strip, similar_strip_tiles returns None for ProfileChatsFetch::Failed, request_similar_chats defers fetch_similar_chats, and fetch_profile_chats skips only Loading and Loaded, so Failed is sent again.
effect: Each failure notifies, redraws and sends the request again: a request loop paced by the round trip, which deepens a flood wait. The strip never shows.
fix: Treat Failed as terminal in the draw path: ask only when the fetch is absent, and retry only from an explicit action or after a changed key.

title: Sign-in phone screen resends getCountries and getCountryCode every frame when the answer is empty, invalid or an error
trigger: Open the sign-in phone step behind a VPN or an IP TDLib cannot place. getCountryCode answers an empty string, or either request errors. apply drops an empty country list and a non 2-letter code, the pending request is gone, and sync_signin (every frame via frame_upkeep) calls fetch_countries and fetch_country_code again.
effect: A request, answer, redraw, request loop while the phone screen is up.
fix: Make each lookup a Fetch<T> in AuthState (idle, loading, ready, failed) so a settled answer, empty or failed, is not asked again until the screen is reopened.

title: Code step shows the rejected new number after a failed Wrong number resend
trigger: On the code step press Wrong number?, type a number TDLib rejects (invalid, flood, banned) and press Continue. submit_phone (auth_ui.rs:79-80) sets submitted_phone and clears editing_phone as soon as the request is sent, not when TDLib accepts it.
effect: TDLib stays in WaitCode for the old number, the screen flips back to the code step, and its body says the code was sent to the new, rejected number (signin_view reads submitted_phone) with the error line under it.
fix: Hold the number as a SignInStep enum (EnterPhone, Sending{phone}, CodeSentTo{phone}) advanced by the auth state change, so a rejected send returns to EnterPhone with the old CodeSentTo intact.

title: SignInUi keeps the sign-in stage as bools and strings in step by hand
trigger: picker_open, editing_phone, touched, banned_dismissed, tick_armed, hint, phone_text and submitted_phone are set from sync_signin, submit_phone, signin_error and button handlers; tick_armed is set before spawn_screen and cleared only by the continuation.
effect: No bug today; a dropped tick or a missed reset would stick the countdown or the phone form.
fix: One SignInStep enum (Phone, PhoneSending, Code, EditingPhone, ...) plus a Ticker handle as Option<Task> that is its own armed state.

title: Three Option<(state, Instant)> clocks mirror the auth state and are re-armed by hand
trigger: sync_signin resets code_clock and email_clock when the delivery or reset value differs and clears them off-step; signin_error resets error_clock and banned_dismissed on a changed or absent error; submit_phone clears code_clock, error_clock, banned_dismissed.
effect: No bug today; any new auth transition that skips one of the places leaves a stale countdown.
fix: Store the clock inside the auth step enum variant that owns it, so leaving the step drops it.

title: Gallery row menu acts on the gallery chat at click time, not the chat the menu was built for
trigger: Right click a gallery row (menu captures message_id and file only), then change the gallery chat before choosing an item (keyboard chat switch, notification click). shared_media_menu_action reads session.media.shared_media.chat_id when the item is clicked.
effect: Forward runs begin_forward_one(new chat, old message id), and ids collide across private chats and basic groups, so a different message can be forwarded. Delete is gated by the actions slot and mostly refused.
fix: Capture an AccountChat/ChatMessage owner key in the menu closure and drop the action when it no longer equals the open gallery chat.

title: A row ticked before its message properties arrive can stay unable to forward or delete
trigger: Hover a gallery row and tick it at once, then move to another row. The tick stores allow-nothing (SelectedMedia::from_actions(None)); the answer lands in the single shared messages.message_menu_actions slot, refresh_from_answer runs only on later hover events, and the next row's request overwrites the slot.
effect: Forward and Delete in the selection bar stay disabled for the whole group until that row is unticked and ticked again.
fix: Send a properties request per ticked message keyed by message id and apply each answer to its selection entry, instead of reading one shared slot on hover.

title: Gallery search field, its key and the keystroke token are kept in step from the layout pass
trigger: keep_shared_media_search_field (called from shell_columns during render) replaces input and sets key when shared_media_search_key changes and bumps keystroke; the query itself lives in SharedMediaTabState::query in the session.
effect: No bug found; two owners (UI field and session tab query) must agree on the text.
fix: One GallerySearch value holding the SearchKey, the field and the debounce task, built and dropped with the open tab.

title: Which kit dialog a window shows is mirrored in QuillShell::open_dialog, the ChatWindows dialog map and the kit layer
trigger: sync_host_dialogs keeps open_dialog, windows.dialog_opened_in/closed_in and the kit dialog layer in step; main_window.dialogs_closed is a bool taken once to reset open_dialog after a switch.
effect: No bug today; any path that closes the kit dialog without on_close_kind or the sync leaves open_dialog naming a dialog that is gone.
fix: A single per-window DialogHost enum (None, Shown(kind)) owned by the window slot, with the kit layer driven only from it.

title: Kit dialog can be closed twice in a transition, closing an unrelated top dialog
trigger: An action clears a dialog flag and calls close_kit_dialog_if_done (window.close_dialog), while the shell still has open_dialog = Some(old). The next sync sees open_dialog != first_open and calls window.close_dialog again before opening the next box.
effect: If another kit dialog (an alert opened with open_alert_dialog) is on top by then, it is closed instead of nothing.
fix: close_kit_dialog_if_done should also clear shell.open_dialog, or the sync should check the kit layer has a dialog before closing.

title: SidebarReveal holds hidden, two glides and a pointer enum that must agree
trigger: set_hidden, pointer_entered, pointer_left, dismiss and settle each move several of hidden, docked, peek and pointer; the glide target must equal hidden.
effect: No bug found; the tests cover the transitions.
fix: Derive the glide targets from one SidebarMode enum (Docked, Hidden{peek: Peek}).

title: A story viewer open in the main window blocks the history shortcuts of every chat window
trigger: Open a story in the main window, then press PageUp, Cmd+Up, Delete on a selection or Ctrl+Space in a chat window. shortcut_blocked reads self.stories.viewer.is_open(), which is the main window's, while self.viewer.state is the window's own.
effect: The shortcuts do nothing in the chat window until the story closes.
fix: Block on this window's own viewer only; the story viewer blocks only when the scope is the main window.

title: Composer spelling and edit menu in a chat window is built from the main window's composer
trigger: Right click a misspelled word in a chat window's composer. composer_context_menu defers build_composer_menu with window.defer, outside in_window_scope, so app.composer, chat_ui and spell state are the main window's.
effect: Suggestions, Cut/Copy enablement, the code-block and emoji items come from the main composer text and selection; the replace is refused or applies to nothing.
fix: Capture the window scope at right-click time and run build_composer_menu inside in_window_scope(scope).

title: recheck_spelling asks the spell backend on the UI thread
trigger: On macOS with the NSSpellChecker worker stuck, use Add to Dictionary, Remove from Dictionary or Ignore. recheck_spelling calls checker.is_correct for every underlined word of every window after the cache was cleared; the macOS backend waits CHECK_WAIT (5 s) per uncached word on the main thread. build_composer_menu also calls is_correct and suggestions there.
effect: The window freezes for seconds per word.
fix: Drop the word from the list by its text and let schedule_spellcheck re-check in the background.

title: Turning spell check on does not check drafts already in the composers
trigger: Turn Check spelling off, type a draft, turn it on again. sync_spellcheck clears misspellings while disabled and nothing re-checks when the setting changes (new_accent_picker.rs:512 only sets the pref).
effect: No underlines until the next edit in each window.
fix: Call recheck_spelling from the setter.

title: ComposerSpelling keeps misspellings, checked_text and a task in step
trigger: sync_spellcheck, schedule_spellcheck, spellcheck_now, recheck_spelling and install_spell_engine each rewrite checked_text, misspellings and task; a result is applied only if checked_text still equals the text it checked.
effect: No bug found.
fix: SpellState enum (Off, Checked{text, misspellings}, Checking{text, task, previous}).

title: DictManager download, task, failed and open are separate Options and a bool
trigger: start_dictionary_download sets download and task and clears failed; the continuation clears download and sets failed or changes languages; cancel is a separate flag inside Progress and the result is recognised by the string "Cancelled.".
effect: No bug today.
fix: DictDownload enum (Idle, Running{code, progress, task}, Failed{code, message}) with a typed Cancelled error.

title: Switching on a second dictionary while one downloads does nothing and says nothing
trigger: Switch on a language, and while it downloads switch on another. start_dictionary_download returns when download.is_some(); the switch draws from row state so it snaps back.
effect: The click is lost without a note.
fix: Queue the second request or show a note.

title: Dictionary rows list the dictionary folder from disk on every render
trigger: Open Manage dictionaries; during a download render runs every 120 ms. dictionary_rows calls installed_codes(&dir) each time.
effect: Disk reads on the UI thread every frame while the list is open.
fix: Cache the installed codes and refresh them on download or remove.

title: Calls and Contacts tabs are two bools set against each other
trigger: demo_showcase_calls and demo_showcase_contacts set calls_tab_open and contacts_tab_open and clear the other by hand (same pair as the chat list's real tab handlers).
effect: No bug in the demo; both true would draw two tabs.
fix: A ChatListTab enum (Chats, Calls, Contacts).

title: Appearance page asks for installed backgrounds on every render, so a failed answer starts a request loop
trigger: Open Settings > Appearance while TDLib answers getInstalledBackgrounds with an error (flood wait, server error). The error sets chats_state.background_error but leaves installed_backgrounds None; the answer re-renders the page, ensure_wallpapers_loaded sees None and no pending request, and sends the request again.
effect: A request plus redraw loop at network round-trip speed for as long as the page is open; the wallpaper section never leaves its loading look.
fix: Hold the gallery as Fetch<Vec<Background>> (idle, loading, ready, failed) and ask only from idle on page arrival (switch_settings_page), not from render; Failed offers a retry.

title: Log out box closes as if it worked when the logout request could not be sent
trigger: Settings > Account > Log out, press Log out while the send fails (request_logout returns Err) or there is no live client. The button handler clears settings.log_out_confirm and then calls close_kit_dialog_if_done unconditionally.
effect: submit_logout's own comment says a failed send must not silently close the dialog, but this box closes anyway; the user sees only a transient error note (or nothing with no live client) and believes the logout started.
fix: Make submit_logout return whether the request went out and clear log_out_confirm and close the box only on success; keep the box with an inline error otherwise.

title: Undo of an agent's send marks the entry Undone although the delete was refused or failed
trigger: Agent sent a message that is no longer in the loaded history (agent_undo_for offers Undo for ids it cannot find, see its own comment). Click Undo, then Delete in the box. delete_selection filters or ConnectDriver::delete_selected refuses, shows an error note, and the on_ok handler still calls activity::mark_undone.
effect: The row shows the Undone tag and loses its Undo button while the message still exists in the chat.
fix: Have delete_selection return Result<Sent, Refused> and mark the entry only on Sent; better, mark it when the deleteMessages answer or the message-deleted update arrives.

title: Undo of an agent's message resets the user's forward draft and selection in an unrelated chat
trigger: In chat X tick messages to forward (ForwardStage::Selecting or the forward bar), open Settings > Agent access > Activity and Undo an agent send in chat Y. delete_selection ends with self.share.forward = ForwardStage::None.
effect: The user's forward in progress is silently dropped; only the agent's delete was asked for.
fix: Split delete_selection into the delete itself and the selection-mode exit, and clear the forward stage only when its draft is for the same chat and the same ids.

title: Undo of a reaction marks the entry Undone even when the toggle did nothing
trigger: Click Undo on a react entry when toggle_reaction returns early (react_premium_feature opens Premium instead) or there is no live client. mark_undone runs right after the call.
effect: The row reads Undone while the reaction is still on the message; Premium may open over Settings.
fix: Make toggle_reaction report whether it sent the change and mark the entry only then.

title: Activity filter outlives the account picked in the Chats section
trigger: Agent access page, Activity: filter by chat A of account 1. In the Chats section pick account 2 from the account menu (agent_ui.picked changes, filter does not). Account 2's log has no chat A.
effect: Activity shows 'nothing matches the filter' while the Chats button reads its default label (the chat is not in the new account's list), so no filter looks active; the user must find 'All' in the menu. The same stale filter also applies when picked changes back.
fix: Make the filter part of one value with the account it was made for (e.g. picked: Option<(AccountKey, ActivityFilter)>), or reset the filter wherever picked changes.

title: How many activity rows show is app-wide and never resets
trigger: Press Show more several times, change a filter or pick another account, or leave the page and return.
effect: Another account or filter opens with an enlarged page of rows (up to hundreds drawn at once); only Clear resets it.
fix: Move the paging count into AgentPageUi next to the filter, reset in leave_agent_page and when the filter or picked account changes.

title: Contact chooser sends to whatever chat is open when a contact is clicked, not the chat it was opened for
trigger: Open Attach > Contact in chat A; before the click, chat B comes to the front in the same window (notification click, link, agent open, Saved Messages jump). Click a contact. submit_share_contact reads share_target() from session.open_chat, and nothing closes content_dialog on a chat change.
effect: The contact card goes to chat B, possibly one the user never meant to share a phone number with (privacy and wrong-target).
fix: Put the destination (AccountChat/ChatId) inside ShareContentDialog when it opens, send to that, and close the dialog in the chat-switch path.

title: Share box drops the forward as if it was sent when there is no live client
trigger: Select messages, open the share box, tick a chat, press Send while self.live is None and demo_session is None (connection closed, remote logout, between accounts). Neither branch runs, failed stays 0, and failed < dests.len() clears the stage and the selection.
effect: The forward draft and ticked chats vanish with no note; nothing was sent.
fix: Make submit_share return a Result and clear the stage only for destinations actually queued; with no live client keep the box and say so.

title: Partial forward failure clears the whole selection, so the failed chats cannot be retried
trigger: Tick three chats; one send fails (failed == 1 < 3). The note says 'could not forward to 1 chat' but forward stage and selection are cleared. When only the comment sent and the forward failed, a retry from scratch repeats the comment.
effect: The user must start the forward again from the message list and cannot tell which chat failed.
fix: Track per-destination outcome (Queued/Failed) in the selection; clear only queued ones and keep the box with the failed chats ticked.

title: Reply-in-another-chat box and forward share box can be open together over one search field and one selection
trigger: With a reply set and reply_elsewhere_open true, start a forward from a selection (open_forward_picker never clears reply_elsewhere_open, while open_reply_elsewhere does close the forward picker). sync_share_search accepts either flag.
effect: Two boxes share one search_input, selection and focus_search flag; a tick in one shows in the other and the second box can take focus away.
fix: One enum ShareChooser { None, Forward(..), ReplyElsewhere } so only one chooser exists and opening one replaces the other.

title: Gallery scroll position and paging mark survive close and reopen of the same chat
trigger: Open the shared-media gallery of chat A, scroll the Media (or Files) tab down, press the close button, open it again for A. close() clears the tabs and restamps them, but PageKey (chat, anchor_day, query) is unchanged and nothing drew another page in between.
effect: The freshly loaded first page opens at the old scroll offset (or at its end, firing the Load more row at once); a list tab's Asked still holds the old length, so the first automatic page is skipped until the reader scrolls.
fix: Add the tab's generation stamp (SharedMediaTabState::generation) to PageKey so a cleared tab is a new page.

title: Add-a-chat picker is rebuilt only when the chat count or granted ids change
trigger: A chat is renamed, or one chat leaves and another joins between renders so the count stays the same, while Agent access is open.
effect: The picker lists stale titles or misses the new chat until the page is left and re-entered.
fix: Key the picker on a session revision counter for the chat list, or derive the item list on each open of the menu instead of caching it.

title: Opening a search result for the page already shown leaves the page but skips its arrival work
trigger: On Settings > Devices (or Data and storage, Notifications) search for a setting of the same page and open it. open_search_target calls leave_settings_page, then show_settings_page returns early in switch_settings_page because the page is unchanged.
effect: The page's drafts are dropped (open session details, storage editor, confirm banner) but the arrival step (fetch_sessions, arrive_data_storage, fetch_notification_settings) does not run, so error lines and the guarded fetch of the visit are skipped.
fix: Treat leave plus arrive as one reset step run for a same-page result as well, or skip the leave when the page is unchanged.

title: Narrow-window back from a page keeps the search Arrival alive, with its animation tick
trigger: Narrow window: open a search result so Arrival is set and its row has been painted, then press the back arrow before the next render has centered it. settings_back sets page = None without clearing arrival; landed stays None so the timeout never starts.
effect: settle_arrival requests an animation tick at 60 fps for the rest of the Settings visit and the wash never ends. Needs a very fast click, so unlikely.
fix: Clear arrival in leave_settings_page (the one place a page is left); make Arrival one enum Seeking / Landed(Instant) / Done.

title: Arrival stage is landed Option<Instant>, centered_at Option and a shared row Cell kept in step by hand
trigger: Search result opens a page: seeking the row, centered, washing, finished.
effect: No bug today beyond 13-TMP-015; the stage is spread over three fields plus the owner's Option<Arrival>.
fix: enum Arrival { Seeking { target, row }, Washing { target, row, landed, centered_at } } with the finish being the owner dropping it.

title: SettingsSearch keeps query text, selected index and pending_clear flag beside the input entity's own value
trigger: Typing, Enter on a result, Esc, closing Settings.
effect: query mirrors the input value on each Change and is reset by hand in clear_settings_search and focus_settings_search; pending_clear is a one-shot 'clear on next render' stage flag.
fix: Read the query from the input entity (single source) and model the field as enum Search { Idle, Typing{selected}, ClearOnNextRender } or clear immediately where a window is at hand.

title: Agent page keeps reset_confirm bool (dialog open flag), picker with picker_key, focus_chat and scroll_to as parallel fields
trigger: Reset the agent token box, the chat menus' Agent access, Add a chat picker.
effect: reset_confirm is cleared by hand in three places in agent_dialogs.rs; picker and picker_key must change together (both reset in two places); focus_chat is only valid for the active account (checked per render).
fix: enum AgentDialog { None, ResetToken } for the box; picker: Option<(PickerKey, ChatPicker)> as one value; focus_chat: Option<AccountChat>.

title: Log out box open state is settings.log_out_confirm bool, second to account_boxes.lifecycle.confirm_logout
trigger: Settings > Account > Log out, and the Account dialog's own logout confirmation.
effect: Two confirm flags for one action, each cleared by hand; submit_logout clears only the lifecycle one.
fix: One enum LogOutBox { Closed, Asking(Origin) } owned by the settings window or the account box, not both.

title: ShareUi stages as flags and Options: focus_search, link_text, forward_result, content_dialog.focus_on_mount
trigger: Forward box opens (focus_search set, taken by whichever box mounts first), share-link chooser, forward result bar, contact chooser.
effect: focus_search is a one-shot 'just opened' flag consumed by two different boxes (forward_box, reply_elsewhere_box) and left set if the box never mounts (locked, hidden), so a later box takes focus unasked; focus_on_mount is the same shape.
fix: Put the 'focus on mount' stage inside the box's own enum (Mounting -> Shown) so the box that owns it consumes it, and give link_text and forward_result an owner enum with a way out on lock and chat change.

title: Gallery tab stage is status plus loading_more bool plus error String plus Asked mark
trigger: Open a tab, scroll to load more pages, a page fails.
effect: status (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed/Empty) is an enum but the next-page stage is a separate loading_more bool read here (and in load_due) and a failed next page has no visible state; the retry rests on Asked and a scroll.
fix: Ready { more: More::{None, Idle, Loading, Failed(err)} } so a failed next page is a state the list can show with a retry row.

title: Closing the Playlist page closes the whole gallery instead of going back to it
trigger: Open the gallery, open a profile's music Playlist page, press the playlist close button. It calls close_shared_media_ui, which closes shared_media entirely.
effect: The user lands on the bare chat with no gallery and the Media tab they were on is gone.
fix: Make the panel one enum Gallery(chat) / Playlist{user, back: Option<Gallery>} and let Playlist close pop to its back value.

title: Clicking a story tile does nothing when the story is not in the loaded stories
trigger: Gallery > Stories tab, click a tile whose story is not in session.stories (not yet fetched or expired). items.iter().position(..) is None and the function returns.
effect: A click that gives no feedback and no request for the story.
fix: Ask for the story (getStory) and show a loading state on the tile, or a note when it is gone.

title: Playlist page shows 'Loading' forever when the playlist is not in the cache
trigger: open_playlist_ui sets playlist_user for a user whose playlist entry is missing (evicted, never fetched, fetch failed). empty is playlist.is_none(); the text picks PROFILE_LOADING and no fetch is asked here.
effect: A spinner-like text with nothing coming; only Close is a way out.
fix: Fetch<Playlist> per user (idle, loading, ready, failed) and ask for the playlist when the page opens.

title: Playlist rows decide 'playing' from a bare message id
trigger: Play a track in the Playlist page of user U in one chat, then open the same track's Playlist (same file id, so same playlist_message_id) while another chat is open. active compares playback.playing_audio with the synthetic id only, and toggle_audio_playback gets chat = open_chat or ChatId(0).
effect: A row can show playing/paused for playback that belongs to another chat key, and a press toggles the other chat's playback.
fix: Compare the full (ChatId, MessageId) owner key, as ChatMessage does, instead of the bare message id.
